description: Ministry of Youth and Sports - Cancel the Registration of the Sri Lanka Powerboat Association
categorisation: This gazette content contains a legal/regulatory action - the cancellation of registration for two national sports associations under the authority of the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973. It involves the exercise of regulatory powers (Section 32(c)) to revoke registrations, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes. While it mentions a minister by name, the primary content is regulatory action, not government personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
